{"tool":"write","path":"reports/export.py","content":""""Reports CSV exporter. Implement export_csv to satisfy TASK.txt."""


def _quote_field(value):
    """Apply RFC 4180 minimal quoting and quote doubling."""
    if value == "" or value is None:
        return ""
    text = str(value)
    if any(ch in text for ch in (",", '"', "\r", "\n")):
        return '"' + text.replace('"', '""') + '"'
    return text


def export_csv(rows, columns):
    """Export mappings in column order as RFC 4180 CSV, including the header.

    rows is an iterable of mappings; columns is an ordered iterable of unique
    string column names. Missing fields and None become empty strings. Other
    values become str(value). Unselected fields are ignored. Inputs are not
    mutated, and one-shot generators are supported for both rows and columns.
    """
    # Materialize columns once: validates, supports one-shot generators,
    # and avoids re-consuming the iterable per row.
    cols = list(columns)
    seen = set()
    for name in cols:
        if not isinstance(name, str):
            raise ValueError("column names must be strings")
        if name in seen:
            raise ValueError("duplicate column name: %r" % name)
        seen.add(name)

    header = ",".join(_quote_field(name) for name in cols)
    lines = [header]

    for row in rows:
        record = ",".join(_quote_field(row.get(name)) for name in cols)
        lines.append(record)

    return "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n"
"}
